summary: Specifies a query language for monitoring and controlling network entities, as part of the High-Level Entity Monitoring System (HEMS). It replaces RFC 1023, extends the language and adds discussion of the underlying issues. It supersedes parts of RFC 1024.

eli5.summary: It is the set of questions and commands you can send to network machines in an early management system, improved from an earlier version.

questions: what is the hems query language
how does hems monitor network entities
